item.text:
## 2B.1 Research Note: Narendra Modi in 2024

**Assessment:** Strong support. In 2024, Modi repeatedly chose **diplomacy, dialogue, and peace-seeking engagement** on the clearest live crisis in his portfolio, the Russia-Ukraine war, even when peaceful alternatives were available. I found **no direct 2024 evidence** that he treated force as the preferred first option; the main counterweight is continued strategic alignment with Russia, which is not the same as choosing force.

### Accepted claims

- **Title:** [Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks with President Zelenskyy](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 20 Mar 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48  
  **Summary:** Modi said India’s approach was “people-centric” and called for dialogue and diplomacy as the way forward, adding that India would do everything within its means to support a peaceful solution. This is direct evidence that he chose **de-escalation over force** where a peaceful path existed.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8

- **Title:** [Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulates President Putin on his re-election](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2015682)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 20 Mar 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2015682  
  **Summary:** In the same day’s call with Putin, Modi reiterated that dialogue and diplomacy were the way forward in the Russia-Ukraine conflict. This is further evidence that he **did not default to force** and instead kept a diplomatic channel open to a key belligerent.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8

- **Title:** [Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks with President Putin](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2049059)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 27 Aug 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2049059  
  **Summary:** Modi again emphasized dialogue, diplomacy, and practical engagement between all stakeholders to achieve an abiding and peaceful resolution of the conflict. This supports a pattern of **persistent de-escalatory choice** rather than force-first behavior.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8

- **Title:** [Prime Minister’s meeting with the President of Ukraine](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2058086&lang=1&reg=3)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 24 Sep 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2058086&lang=1&reg=3  
  **Summary:** Modi reiterated India’s “clear, consistent and constructive approach” in favor of a peaceful resolution through diplomacy and dialogue, and said India remained open to provide support for a lasting and peaceful settlement. This is the strongest 2024 evidence that he chose **compromise and de-escalation** when peaceful alternatives were available.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8

- **Title:** [English Translation of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi's Opening Remarks at the QUAD Leaders' Summit](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2057440)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 22 Sep 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2057440  
  **Summary:** Modi said the world was full of tensions and conflicts, but the Quad supported sovereignty, territorial integrity, and the peaceful resolution of all issues. This is broader but still relevant evidence of **preferring de-escalation and rules-based compromise**.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8

- **Title:** [Reuters report on Modi’s call with Putin after the children’s hospital strike](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452)  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 9 Jul 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452  
  **Summary:** Reuters reported Modi rebuked Putin in civilian-protective terms after a hospital strike in Ukraine. That is consistent with **clear de-escalatory crisis communication** rather than treating force as the first option.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.8, 1B.2

### Weak counterweight / not a direct refutation

- **Title:** [Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulates President Putin on his re-election](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2015682)  
  **Publisher:** Prime Minister’s Office / PIB  
  **Date:** 20 Mar 2024  
  **URL:** https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2015682  
  **Summary:** The call also said India and Russia would further strengthen their special and privileged strategic partnership. This shows **continued alignment with Russia**, but it does not show a force-first choice; the same call still explicitly prioritized diplomacy and peace.  
  **Question IDs:** 2B.1, 1B.1

### Search gap

- I found **no direct 2024 evidence** that Modi chose force over peaceful alternatives when such alternatives existed.
- I also found **no documented 2024 crisis where he rejected a credible compromise path** in favor of immediate coercion.
- So the best-supported conclusion is: **Modi generally chose diplomacy and de-escalation in 2024, especially on Ukraine, rather than force as the first option.**
